art_direction: 高拱短眼共同望上方，宽黑瞳与简洁高光，眉间舒展。
composition: centered pair of coordinated eyes with restrained brows and short mouth; ample pale negative space

color_randomization.method: seeded golden-angle hue spacing with random harmony, saturation, lightness, and shuffled color modes

creative_direction: Give the pair a taller, compact comic construction with smoothly domed upper lids and shallow lower bowls. Both pupils look gently upward toward the same point, avoiding a startled gaze. Their large dark forms should occupy much of each opening, interrupted by one generous graphic highlight. Outline the eyes with a delicate continuous line, adding only a modest dark accent at each upper outer quarter. Keep white corner space small and the iris fields simple. The two short brows rise slightly as a coordinated pair, while a tiny straight mouth stays close below. Preserve natural pointed corners and comparable eye sizes. The centered face conveys interested anticipation rather than exaggerated innocence.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: inspected: centered two-eye composition and archive integrity; retained as an unsuccessful style experiment after user feedback that the clean contours, recurring round pupils and regular highlights look too AI-generated; do not count as an accepted final image
batch_status: stopped after user style feedback; no further generation in this direction
